modeling_role: Defines the infrastructure layers represented by rows and columns
review_requirement: Document whether sectors represent services assets operators regions facilities or institutional functions
responsible_use_warning: Sector-level models can hide asset-level bottlenecks and uneven service impacts

review_requirement: State whether dependencies are physical cyber geographic operational economic institutional or mixed
responsible_use_warning: Different dependency types should not be mixed without documentation

modeling_role: Defines how dependency weights were estimated
review_requirement: Record whether weights come from operational data historical events expert judgment simulations or scenario assumptions
responsible_use_warning: Judgment-based weights require sensitivity testing and uncertainty flags

modeling_role: Defines how disruption is propagated across sectors
review_requirement: Document whether the model uses one-step multi-step linear threshold delayed or nonlinear propagation
responsible_use_warning: Linear cascade estimates should not be treated as predictions without validation

modeling_role: Records backups alternative paths spare capacity reserves and workarounds
review_requirement: Document backup duration fuel access capacity staffing and geographic availability
responsible_use_warning: Redundancy on paper may not be usable during regional disruptions

modeling_role: Connects service loss to people places and uneven vulnerability
review_requirement: Review whether aggregate sector losses hide concentrated impacts across communities
responsible_use_warning: Average service loss can understate harm to vulnerable populations

modeling_role: Records whether modeled dependencies and cascades have evidence support
review_requirement: Compare results with historical disruptions exercises operational records and domain expertise
responsible_use_warning: Unvalidated cascade scenarios should be communicated as exploratory

modeling_role: Defines what the model can and cannot support
review_requirement: Attach interpretation limits uncertainty notes review status and stop-use conditions to outputs
responsible_use_warning: The model should inform public decisions not replace accountable institutional judgment
